hooks.command: printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "additionalContext": "PLANNING GATE: Before entering plan mode, ensure you have multi-model advisory context. If you have NOT yet consulted Codex architect_review or Antigravity antigravity_brainstorm in this session for the current task, call them NOW (in PARALLEL, same message) (they work in plan mode since plan mode supports all tools except Write/Edit). DISPATCH BLIND: give them the REQUIREMENT and CONSTRAINTS and ask them to solve it \u2014 do NOT paste the design you already picked and ask them to bless it, which returns agreement rather than architecture. Put any preferred design in the caller_hypothesis parameter so it is refuted instead of confirmed. Expect live web research with source URLs for prior art and version claims. If multi-model advisory has already run, proceed into plan mode."}}'

INPUT=$(cat); COMMAND=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s\n' "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+(push|commit)'; then TRANSCRIPT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); if [ -n "$TRANSCRIPT" ] && [ -f "$TRANSCRIPT" ] && grep -q code_review "$TRANSCRIPT" 2>/dev/null && grep -q antigravity_review_pr "$TRANSCRIPT" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; else printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "additionalContext": "PUSH GATE: You are about to git push/commit, but the transcript for this session does not show BOTH a Codex code_review and an Antigravity antigravity_review_pr. Per multi-model workflow you MUST run both on the diff before pushing, dispatched in PARALLEL (same message). DISPATCH BLIND: send the DIFF and let them find the defects. Do NOT write \"I fixed X by doing Y, confirm that is right\" \u2014 that buys agreement, not review, and two models handed the same claim agree for reasons unrelated to the code. Keep context and focus factual; put any belief of your own in the caller_hypothesis parameter for an explicit CONFIRMED/REFUTED/UNPROVEN verdict. If the user explicitly said skip review, proceed. Otherwise, STOP and run both reviews first."}}'; fi; else exit 0; fi
